question.problem:
$$
{P}_{B\to C}=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 1 \\ 7 & -1 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

 

The change-of-coordinates matrix from the basis $B={{b}_{1},{b}_{2},{b}_{3}}$ to the basis $C={{c}_{1},{c}_{2},{c}_{3}}$ is given above. Find $[x]_{C}$ given that $x=4{b}_{3}-2{b}_{1}.$
question.worked_solution:
First, notice that since $x=4{b}_{3}-2{b}_{1},$ we have

$$
[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 0 \\ 4\end{aligned}].
$$

 

Given the coordinates of $x$ relative to $B$ and the change-of-coordinates matrix from $B$ to $C,$ we find the coordinates of $x$ relative to $C$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}[\,x\,]_{C} & ={P}_{B\to C}[\,x\,]_{B} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 1 \\ 7 & -1 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 0 \\ 4\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -14 \\ 2\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
